rows.indexdef: CREATE INDEX xi_a_idx ON public.xi USING btree (EXTRACT("MONTH" FROM d)) WHERE (EXTRACT("Hour" FROM ti) > 1.0)
CREATE INDEX xi_b_idx ON public.xi USING btree (EXTRACT(month FROM d)) WHERE (EXTRACT(hour FROM ti) > 1.0)
CREATE INDEX xi_c_idx ON public.xi USING btree (EXTRACT("select" FROM d)) WHERE (EXTRACT("my""x" FROM ti) IS NOT NULL)
